note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The document carries ONLY editable placeholder text: section headings, neutral placeholder bars and numbered placeholder paragraphs; a line means only that a paragraph is placed in that section (as supplied). No decision content, ruling, party outcome, costs, reasons, test or appeal information is drawn; jurisdiction unspecified.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Three participants: the two section cards and the numbered paragraphs are pulled out of the room to a band above it and labelled on the plan; the reader reads out each section and each section is linked to its paragraphs (as supplied), A and B together; two tracers run the mirror routes at the same time; the paragraphs are the focus.
